name: Tab Notes
description: Offline English example for Plugin API 1.1: per-tab session state with revision-conflict retry. No terminal connection, model or server needed.
author: AITerminal community
instructions: Use when the user wants to try or inspect per-tab session state: add, show or clear notes in the current tab. Offline demo only; state is per tab and cleared on disable, update, tab close or app exit.

tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Append one note to this tab's session state, retrying on revision conflict.

tools.title: Show this tab's notes
tools.description: Publish the notes stored for the current tab to the notes panel.

tools.title: Clear this tab's notes
tools.description: Empty this tab's list after an explicit confirm.
